implementation.demand: Conservative bounding-sphere cells only for >=1000 records in normal views; direct baseline loop for smaller maps, overview and malformed bounds. Candidate flags preserve original placement order and the close 360-degree prefetch path.
implementation.shadows: Existing visibility cells provide conservative full-AABB candidates within maximum retained caster range; no camera-frustum restriction; original shadow policy, hysteresis and record order retained.
unchanged: texture pacing, budgets, loads and releases

scope: Current authored maps: demand index applies to great-plains only; shadow candidates apply to all four maps. Index is built once per environment lazily and rebuilt when record count changes. No index is built for overview-only views.

validation.equivalence: Frozen baseline demand and original shadow policy exact ordered outputs on four maps, desktop/touch, moving/turning cameras, 100/200%, synthetic cave fog and four authored terrain height fields. Added NaN fail-open, giant bounds, threshold and behind-camera close prefetch cases.

limits: All candidate statistics are expensive narrow checks; cheap full-record flag filtering and cell overhead remain.
CPU timings are Node NullEngine local samples including candidate work, without browser, GPU or device FPS. Host load and JIT noise apply.
No visual quality or FPS claim without target-device measurement.
The direct and indexed demand loops duplicate policy code and must remain aligned; tests use a frozen baseline oracle.
